### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #38504

Problem Summary:

Using the `tidb_auth_token` plugin for authentication.

### What is changed and how it works?

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [x] Unit test
- [ ] Integration test
- [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
	- Construct a JWT and JWKS for testing, see the next section
- [ ] No code

#### Manual test

##### Preparation

1. `go install github.com/cbcwestwolf/generate_jwt`
2. `cd tidb &&  wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CbcWestwolf/generate_jwt/master/JWKS.json`
3. edit the configuration file `config.toml`
```toml
[security]
auth-token-jwks = "JWKS.json"
```
4. start the tidb-server: `./bin/tidb-server -config config.toml`
5. create the user using the `root` user: `mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -P 4000 -uroot -D test --prompt="tidb> "`
```sql
create user 'user@pingcap.com' identified with 'tidb_auth_token' require token_issuer 'issuer-abc' attribute '{"email": "user@pingcap.com"}'
```

##### Success to auth

1. generate a JWT:
```bash
generate_jwt --kid "the-key-id-0" --sub "user@pingcap.com" --email "user@pingcap.com" --iss "issuer-abc"
```
2. use the JWT to auth
```bash
mycli -h 127.0.0.1 -P 4000 -u 'user@pingcap.com' -p '<the-JWT-generated>' --prompt="tidb> "
```
Note that the mysql client should support `mysql_clear_password` auth plugin. [`mycli`](https://www.mycli.net/) enables `mysql_clear_password` by default. If you are using [`mysql`](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/mysql.html), you should use an `--enable-cleartext-plugin` option that enables the plugin.

##### Fail to auth

Just change the claim like `sub` to "wronguser@pingcap.com".

[jwt.io](https://jwt.io/#debugger-io) may help.

Side effects

- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more CPU
- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more Memory
- [ ] Breaking backward compatibility

Documentation

- [ ] Affects user behaviors
- [ ] Contains syntax changes
- [ ] Contains variable changes
- [ ] Contains experimental features
- [ ] Changes MySQL compatibility

### Release note

<!-- compatibility change, improvement, bugfix, and new feature need a release note -->

```release-note
1. add configuration `security.auth-token-jwks` and `security.auth-token-refresh-interval`
6. support passwordless authentication `tidb_auth_token`
```

issue_context.title: Support authentication using a token/JWT
issue_context.body:
Token-based authentication is a passwordless way of connecting to a DB.  Nowadays TiDB supports `tidb_session_token` to conveniently transfer connections with TiProxy, but lacks a way for users to connect safely without a password. A new authentication plugin (maybe named `tidb_auth_token` can be implemented in concert with `mysql_clear_password` on client-side.

1. [x] Create User using `tidb_auth_token` https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/38585
2. [x] Authenticate User using `tidb_auth_token` https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/38773

review_comments: The certs can be generated by `util.CreateCertificates()`. Just a suggestion, it's up to you.
It's better to manage the goroutine by `waitgroup.WaitGroup` and close the goroutine when the server shuts down.
Since there is only one goroutine performing reloading, I prefer not to add `WaitGroup` until we need to support changing the path of JWKS (and therefore call `LoadJWKS4AuthToken` again).
It is not about reloading or dynamic path. It is about the exit of the goroutine.
